name: careerpilot
description: CareerPilot — a personal, human-in-the-loop AI job application agent.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace web && npm run test:api
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
